name: What are the common foundation options for a tiny home placed on a property?

mainEntity.name: What are the common foundation options for a tiny home placed on a property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common foundation options for tiny homes placed on a property include concrete slab, pier and beam, or a crawl space. A concrete slab provides a solid, permanent base, ideal for stable, level ground. Pier and beam foundations elevate the tiny home, suitable for uneven terrain or flood-prone areas, allowing for utility access underneath. A crawl space offers similar benefits to pier and beam but provides more enclosed space beneath the structure. The choice depends on local building codes, soil conditions, and your budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common tiny home foundations are concrete slab, pier and beam, or crawl space. The best choice depends on local codes, soil conditions, and whether you need to elevate the home.
